summary: Full-app regression pass after 'AI-slop / dead-button' polish. Covered (a) backend Auditor Pack PDF endpoint, (b) tenant admin end-to-end click-through (Overview/Fleet/Team/Reports/Announcements sub-tabs + top nav to Live Sheet/Alerts/Behaviour/Admin), (c) Manage Vehicles dialogs on /admin?tab=cars, (d) Command Centre (Suspend + Regenerate-magic-link styled confirms), and (e) Staff mobile app (Home/Bookings/Docs/Lift). RESULT: All requested polish items pass. (1) NEW backend PDF endpoint GET /api/tenant/reports/compliance-pack/pdf returns 200 application/pdf, valid %PDF header, requires admin (staff -> 403, unauth -> 403). Auditor Pack (PDF) blue button (data-testid=download-auditor-pack-button) visible on Admin > Reports and triggers download of compliance_pack_bluebirdcaredublinfleet_20260824.pdf. (2) EMOJI SWEEP: Ran a Unicode emoji regex leaf-node scan on every screen visited (Tenant Overview, Fleet cards, Team, Reports (Fleet Reports / Incident Reports / Documents / Daily Timeline sub-tabs), Announcements, Live Sheet, Alerts, Behaviour, Admin Panel > Fleet / Team / Reports, Command Centre Dashboard, Command Centre Clients, Staff Home/Bookings/Docs/Lift) — all CLEAN, zero emoji-as-icon leaks. (3) STATUSBADGE: rewritten component renders colour pill + dot correctly on Fleet Board (Overview) — no missing/blank badges, no emoji. (Admin > Fleet card view intentionally shows plain 'Status: Free/Blocked' text, not the StatusBadge pill — that view uses its own text.) (4) COMMAND CENTRE styled confirms — verified programmatically: window.confirm was monkey-patched to count native calls; on both 'Regenerate magic link' and 'Suspend tenant' actions native count stayed at 0 and a styled dialog appeared with proper text ('Generate a new magic link? Any previous link for "Prospect Demo A" stops working immediately.' and 'Suspend this tenant? They will lose access immediately.'), then Cancel was clicked. Plan comparison cards render (no emoji). (5) MANAGE VEHICLES: Add Car / Edit / Delete / QR / Block-for-Appointment / Sign-Off-Unblock buttons all present on /admin?tab=cars; Block-for-Appointment modal opens & closes cleanly. (6) STAFF MOBILE at /test-fleet/login (390x844): teststaff logs in, Home/Bookings/Docs/Lift bottom nav renders, no emoji anywhere on any tab, 'New Booking' button present on Bookings, Lift tab renders. (7) NO 'jsx' non-boolean-attribute React warning surfaces anywhere any more (previous iteration reported this on every page — now zero). (8) Console-error scan: only ONE React warning across the entire sweep — 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' fired in Admin render when the Reports tab loads. Non-breaking (renders correctly, PDF works) but should be fixed for Enterprise Ireland demo.
